description:
This beautifully presented four-bedroom detached bungalow is ideally positioned within the mature and well-established Clonmore Heights development in Mullingar. Maintained to an excellent standard throughout, the property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation, landscaped gardens and a highly convenient location within walking distance of Mullingar town centre and the train and bus stations.

The accommodation opens with an entrance hall finished with semi-solid timber flooring and providing access to the attic and hotpress. The comfortable living room features matching timber flooring and a cast-iron open fireplace. A particular highlight is the impressive kitchen and dining room, offering generous space. The fully fitted kitchen is finished with quartz countertops and splashback, tiled flooring and spotlights, while an archway provides a natural division between the kitchen and dining areas. An adjoining utility room offers additional fitted storage and countertop space together with laundry facilities.

There are four well-proportioned bedrooms, all finished with laminate flooring. The primary bedroom benefits from a walk-in wardrobe and private en-suite shower room. The main family bathroom is finished with tiled flooring and walls and features a Jacuzzi bath.

Externally, the property is complemented by mature landscaped gardens and a private, secure rear garden. A cobblelock driveway provides ample off-street parking, and a security gate and generous side entrance.

Clonmore Heights is a mature, low-density residential development offering a peaceful setting while remaining exceptionally convenient to Mullingar town centre. The property is within walking distance of all everyday amenities, together with Mullingar train and bus stations, providing excellent transport connections. Easy access to the surrounding road network also makes the property particularly suitable for commuters.

Combining the convenience of single-storey living with four-bedroom accommodation, excellent condition and a mature residential setting close to the heart of Mullingar. Viewing is highly recommended.
